## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 Substantial textual parallels and citations appear in the commentary literature, particularly the *Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā* and *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (for example, shared material in segments §20.1–21.3) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, recurring stock verses—most notably covering segment ranges §28.1–32.1—are shared with numerous other poems in the Apadāna collection, including the *Rādhattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 541), *Cūḷasugandhattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 552), *Vakkalittheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 534), *Kaṅkhārevatattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 544), *Soṇātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 26), and *Kisāgotamītherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 22) [DharmaNexus].
